## ✅ Acceptance Criteria

### Functionality
- [ ] All required endpoints implemented and working
- [ ] Proper HTTP status codes (200, 201, 400, 404, etc.)
- [ ] Input validation on all endpoints
- [ ] Error handling with clear error messages
- [ ] Async/await used throughout

### Code Quality
- [ ] Code compiles without errors or warnings
- [ ] Follows SOLID principles
- [ ] No code duplication (DRY)
- [ ] Meaningful variable and method names
- [ ] Consistent indentation and formatting

### Testing
- [ ] Unit tests written and passing
- [ ] Integration tests for API endpoints
- [ ] Test coverage 70%+ for critical logic
- [ ] Edge cases tested (empty data, invalid input, etc.)
- [ ] All tests passing before PR

### Documentation
- [ ] XML documentation on all public classes/methods
- [ ] README with API usage examples
- [ ] Example requests/responses provided
- [ ] Complex logic has inline comments
